description.zh: 从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。最小取值为1。
description.en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from Page 1.

description.zh:
驱动ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**驱动管理**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标驱动名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The ID of the driver. To obtain the driver ID, perform the following steps: Log on to the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list). On the **Drivers** page, move the pointer over the name of the driver whose versions you want to query and obtain the driver ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~) operation to query the driver ID.

description.zh: 驱动版本号。设置该参数表示仅查询该版本号匹配的驱动版本信息。
description.en: The version number of the driver. To query information about a specific driver version, set this parameter to the specific version number.

description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: The ID of the Internet of Things (IoT) service instance. This parameter is not required for the public instance but required for Enterprise Edition instances.

description.zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数量。最大取值30，最小取值1，默认取值是10。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 30. Default value: 10.

description.zh:
驱动版本状态。

- 0：表示查询未发布的驱动版本。
- 1：表示查询已发布的驱动版本。
description.en:
The status of the driver version. Valid values:

*   0: The driver version to be queried is not published.
*   1: The driver version to be queried is published.

title.zh: 分页查询驱动版本列表

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。

> RAM用户共享主账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Limits

Each Alibaba Cloud account can run a maximum of 10 queries per second (QPS).

>  RAM users of an Alibaba Cloud account share the quota of the account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot query-edge-driver-version --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --page-size 15 --current-page 1 --driver-id fec565038d7544978d9aed5c1a000000 --driver-version 'led驱动' --version-state 0 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
